title: SQLite persistence: disk databases and WAL mode
description:
Move all four SQLite databases from in-memory to on-disk so state survives restarts.

Why this issue exists:
All SQLite databases currently use in-memory mode. On restart all article numbers, overview data, and credentials are lost. Production deployments require durable state.

What needs to be done:
- Add [database] section to reader config with path settings
- Startup directory and writability checks
- Enable WAL mode on all four databases
- Idempotent backfill on reader restart (re-synthesise article numbers from group log)
- Update integration tests to use tempdir instead of in-memory
